messages.subject: For Emirates leadership | Global aviation, government partnerships and stakeholder strategy
messages.body:
Dear Emirates Media Relations Team,

Please place this executive introduction before Emirates Group senior leadership.

Emirates' global aviation footprint depends on disciplined alignment across governments, aviation authorities, tourism partners, airports and major infrastructure stakeholders. That interface closely matches my current experience.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My responsibilities span government and regulatory relations, corporate affairs, ESG, strategic partnerships and executive advisory, including coordination with aviation and other public authorities in a complex operating environment.

I would welcome a senior discussion about where this combination of government relations, aviation coordination and strategic stakeholder management might support Emirates' international priorities. My attached CV has been tailored specifically to Emirates Group.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
ragunauthramsaroop@icloud.com
